verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog says Linear Agent sets up, runs, and tests code in cloud coding sessions. It also says the agent opens the app in the browser, navigates through a flow to verify its implementation, and captures before-and-after screenshots for review alongside the code. That matches every element of the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth docs beyond brief changelog entries (e.g., how screenshots are surfaced and what verification covers).
